item.title: StackRender: Open-Source Database Schema Design and Automation Tool
item.description: StackRender is an open-source visual schema designer supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, foreign key cycle detection, index recommendations, and AI-assisted generation.

item.title: MaxKB: An Open-Source Agent Platform Unifying RAG and Workflows
item.description: MaxKB combines RAG pipelines, visual agent workflows, and MCP tool integration on top of PostgreSQL and pgvector without requiring a separate vector database.

item.title: How Instagram Scaled PostgreSQL to 2 Billion Users Without Jumping to NoSQL
item.description: How Instagram scaled PostgreSQL to 2 billion users using PgBouncer connection pooling, logical sharding, 64-bit Snowflake IDs, and partial indexes.

item.title: Beopmang: Pre-Parsed Korean Statute JSON and Vector Search for AI Agents
item.description: Parsing raw government statute XML breaks tables and burns preprocessing time. Beopmang serves Korean statutes as clean JSON with built-in pgvector search.
